law: On iOS, use the EventKitUI framework to show calendar and reminder information to the user modally.
The view controllers you’ll use on iOS are: , for displaying existing events.
To access the event store, which contains calendar and reminder data, use EventKit.
Use the calendar chooser view controller to allow users to select one or more calendars when creating or editing a calendar event.
Use a delegate that conforms to to receive callbacks when the user selects calendars or cancels an operation.
To avoid throwing an exception, ensure that the event is in the specified event store.
